description: Primary agentic mint. Emails a one-time approve link to an allowlisted or approved-waitlist address. Returns poll_token. Does not mint a key until the link is opened. Rejects other addresses. Optional partner_id mints an lf_agent_ key whose scopes carry that partner claim (allowlist only). Omit partner_id for a generic agent key. Developer keys are not minted here. Founder UI is backup.

partner_id.description: Optional partner id. Must be on LAUNCHFILES_PARTNER_ALLOWLIST or the call returns UNKNOWN_PARTNER and sends no email. The minted secret stays lf_agent_ and stores partner_id:<id> in scopes.

name: launchfiles_request_agent_key
